title: Contribute
heading: Bring a story to the table.
description: Suggest a story, source or future article for Viking Legacy & Lore. Learn what to include in a pitch and how to contact the publication.
intro: Have a Viking-world story worth exploring? Send a short idea by email. We are gathering suggestions for the podcast and the future written publication.

sections.heading: Start with a short pitch
paragraphs: Tell us the central question, why the story interests you, and what a listener or reader would take away. A paragraph or two is enough to begin.

sections.heading: Give us a trail to follow
paragraphs: Include the sources you would use, with links or publication details. If the idea involves an image, translation or quotation, identify its creator and where it was published.

sections.heading: Tell us about your perspective
paragraphs: Add a short introduction and any relevant experience or previous work you would like to share. Ideas from curious readers are welcome alongside proposals from writers and researchers.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: Email is the current route for ideas; there is no contributor account or upload portal. Sending a pitch does not guarantee a response or publication. Scope, credit, permissions and any payment would need to be discussed before commissioned work begins.
